text.tspan: HELIOS PI - RGB LEVEL SHIFTER PINOUT
The SN74AHCT125RGYR is a quad buffer/line driver specifically designed to interface
between different voltage domains, most commonly acting as a
3.3V to 5V logic level shifter. It is highly regarded for converting 3V microcontroller logic
(like Raspberry Pi or Teensy) to 5V device logic (like NeoPixels/WS2812B/SK6812 LEDs)
